findings.message: tasks.md task 6.3 claims to list 'the tests that name the old token' (src/styles/tokens.test.ts, src/views/grid/HourStrip.test.tsx, src/views/shared/dayTrackGradient.test.ts, src/test/features/time_selection/steps/time_selection_labels_e2e.steps.ts), but the repository has more files that use the removed names or API and that no task names: src/test/features/main_page/steps/themeTokens.ts:77 (`readTokenHex(themeBlock, "day-work")`), src/test/features/time_selection/steps/dayColourChecks.ts (imports `DAY_PERIOD_SCHEDULE, getDayPeriod` from `@/model`; `work: DayColour.WORK`), src/test/features/day_colouring/steps/dayColouringChecks.ts:15 (`work: DayColour.WORK`), src/test/features/grid_view/steps/grid_view_hour_cells_unit.steps.tsx:67 (`["9-17", DayColour.WORK]`) and src/presenter/dayColours.test.ts:53 (`DayColour.WORK`). Task 6.3's own M2 grep and the typecheck in 9.1 would fail on them. Name them in the tasks that own them (6.1, 6.3, 7.3, 8.1).

Tasks 3.4 and 7.2 say solar days are 'counted through src/test/workCounters.ts' and are counted with 'the solar-day counter', but workCounters.ts has no such counter: `WorkCount` only exposes formatters, formattersByZone, displayNames, collators, transitionLookups, transitionLookupsByZone and normalizations. No task adds the counter or says how a test can count calls inside src/model/sun.ts (for example an exported counting seam or hook), so the NFR-P1 and NFR-P3 work-bound tests have no plan. Add an explicit step that writes the counter and its test.

findings.message: specs/day-periods/spec.md:56 (Murmansk 2026-06-21, 'The polar cases') contradicts FR1, which says morning runs 'from solar midnight to solar noon and evening from solar noon to solar midnight'. Murmansk's solar noon is about 12:45-12:46 MSK (the December row of the same table says 12:45), so solar midnight is about 00:46 MSK. The 21 June day therefore starts in evening (00:00 to about 00:46), then morning until about 03:12. The row's 'morning until about 03:12 … morning again from solar midnight' puts morning at the start of the day and puts the next morning on 22 June, outside the day. This row is one of the 12 M1 reference cases used by tasks 2.4 and 3.2, so it must be corrected (for example: evening until solar midnight at about 00:46, morning until about 03:12, day, evening from about 22:26, no night).

Glossary coverage is incomplete. .claude/rules/glossary.md says 'Every new type, function, constant and i18n key names a glossary concept, or the change adds that concept's entry' and 'A change that shifts a term's meaning, owner … updates the entry in the same change'. Task 1.1 and the proposal's glossary list miss three items: (a) the new owner getSunCoordinates (src/model/sunCoordinates.ts), which decides which coordinates a location's sun uses (spec requirement 'Coordinates of a location for the sun'), is not added to any entry (for example Coordinates in docs/glossary/locations.md or Zone coordinates); (b) the 'Day colour' entry (docs/glossary/time-selection.md:35, 'a day period, plain, working time or non-working time', Code: DayColour…) is not updated for the new DayColour.NO_DAY_PERIOD, the neutral colour of a location without day periods; (c) DAY_PERIOD_BLEND_MINUTES is not named as a Code owner of the rewritten 'Blend window'.

Task 9.1's M2 check runs `grep -rniE "…|day-period schedule" … docs/architecture`. The Q3 row title in docs/architecture/open-questions.md:14 is 'Day-period schedule and working hours', and task 1.2 only says to 'close Q3' without renaming that title. As written, task 9.1's grep is not satisfiable by following task 1.2; task 1.2 should say to rewrite the Q3 row title too.
